notes.title: Metaneurosis Roadmap + Demo Changes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share a quick update on where things are headed. I’ve put together a visual roadmap outlining what’s coming next for Metaneurosis, from new world content to upcoming polish and side quests.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/c29ced27396d0aa96c02a550ba4d374bf1866e56.png"]

Demo Update:

The demo has been updated to include all the new changes made to the game's mechanics. It now has all the same features and QoL improvements as the main game.



Thank You:

Seriously, thanks so much to everyone who has played, left feedback, or even just wishlisted the game. This project means a lot to me, and your support is what helps keep it moving forward.

As always, feel free to drop thoughts, theories, or just weird observations in the discussions — especially with how much bizarre stuff there is in this game.

More soon!

— Lazy Dev Studio

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/8a60dd21ff0280a94754a8fcf41014bab519dc51.gif"]
